digest.component_or_area: LLM provider abstraction and parity testing
propositions: Bedrock's Converse API must be validated as a production-ready LLM substrate by applying rebar's non-inferiority parity bar to a paired corpus of 30 eval cases before the S8 cutover, with provider as the only variable.

The parity run must prove payload equivalence, tool parity, and provider-clean routing across both class slots (standard/frontier), with decision-level model-behavior agreement measurement as informational rather than gating.

Both inference-profile model IDs must be invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 and must handle temperature parameters consistently per model capability overrides, with zero validation/auth failures in the corpus run.

The corpus selector must exclude agentic disposable-store arms (completion-verifier, ticket-quality, spec-alignment) and pool ≥20 gold items from eligible specs using epoch-majority aggregation, without lowering min_gold from its parity.py default.
